children: The People's Bank of China (PBOC) held its benchmark lending rates unchanged at record lows for the 16th consecutive month in September 2026, meeting market expectations. The one-year loan prime rate, the benchmark for corporate and consumer borrowing, was kept at 3.0%. The five-year LPR, which serves as the reference rate for residential mortgages, remained flat at 3.5%.
The central bank maintained a cautious monetary stance amid heightened Middle East geopolitical tensions, while strong global demand for AI-related goods continued to support Chinese exports.

gaining 0.4% to 3,925 and the Shenzhen Component rising 0.8% to 13,743. In currency markets, the offshore yuan held firm near 6.69 per dollar, maintaining its strongest level against the greenback since July 2022.
